Game Overview

Among Akero Bots 2 is a adventure title where navigate a futuristic realm as Akero, the adventurous bot, in a quest for magical gems. Master double jumps and precise moves to overcome enemy bots, rotating lasers, and spikes. With eight escalating levels, your survival depends on strategic maneuvers and nerves of steel. Can you outsmart the mechanical mayhem?
